contentHtml:
A wobbly screen, a gap opening up between the lid and the base, or a grinding noise every time you open it: a laptop hinge only gets worse if you leave it, and it usually takes the screen or the case with it. I fix hinges for every major brand across Stretton and Brisbane, most within 24 to 48 hours, with a free quote up front and a warranty on the repair.

A faulty hinge rarely fixes itself

Left alone, a failing hinge cracks the screen, splits the case and strains the ribbon cable behind it, which turns a small job into a big one. Here is what to watch for:

  • Loose or broken hinge, the screen wobbles or will not stay at the angle you set.
  • Won't open or close properly, stiff or catching, which leads to cracks over time.
  • Screen separating from the base, a visible gap where the hinge is pulling away.
  • Grinding or clicking when you open or close it, usually internal hinge damage.
  • Cracks around the hinge area, clear physical wear that needs attention before it spreads.

How the repair works

  • Free assessment. I inspect the hinge and the damage around it and give you a clear quote before anything starts.
  • Repair or replace. Depending on how bad it is, I either repair the existing hinge or fit a good-quality replacement part.
  • Testing. I check the hinge holds firm and the laptop opens and closes smoothly, without strain on the screen.
  • Pickup and warranty. Your laptop is ready to collect, backed by a warranty on the work.

What affects the cost

Every laptop and every hinge failure is a little different, so you get a free, clear quote before I book anything in. The price comes down to a few things:

  • How bad the damage is, a minor adjustment costs less than a full replacement.
  • Brand and model, some designs are more involved to open up than others.
  • Parts availability, the cost of a quality replacement hinge varies by model.

Every major brand, MacBooks included

Loose and stiff hinges are common on MacBook Air and Pro, and just as common on Dell, HP, Lenovo, ASUS, Acer and the rest. Whatever you have, I can quote it. If the screen itself is cracked as well, see my laptop screen replacement page, and for anything else there is laptop repairs and Mac repairs.

Do not wait for the screen to crack. Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
